narrative.overview: Vera Visa's interface reads as a physical document being processed by a trusted local expert, not a SaaS dashboard wearing a travel theme. Every recurring surface takes the shape of a stamped visa page or boarding-pass stub: a flat paper or sand rectangle, a hairline warm border, monospace data fields, and exactly one orange mark standing in for the stamp itself. The system explicitly rejects the cold blue corporate-agency template and the delicate boutique law-firm look. Specificity is part of the visual system, not just the copy: real THB figures, week counts, and visa codes sit in the same monospace voice as the eyebrows, so precision reads as a design property.
keyCharacteristics: Flat, printed-document surfaces — no shadows, no gradients, no glass
One accent color (Visa Stamp Orange) marking exactly one thing per view
Monospace data fields and eyebrows carrying the official-document precision
Fraunces display type for warmth and confidence; Inter for dense, readable body copy under stress
A perforated tear-off edge as the system's one signature ornamental detail

rules.name: The One Stamp Rule
rules.body: Orange marks exactly one thing per view — a button, a status dot, one highlighted headline word. Never a background wash, never more than ~10% of any surface.

rules.name: The Alternating Ledger Rule
rules.body: Sections alternate Passport Paper and Manila Folder Sand for rhythm instead of gray dividers or shadows.

rules.name: The No-Gray Rule
rules.body: There is no gray in this system. Every neutral is a warm tint of ink or a sand/line value.

rules.name: The Engraved Headline Rule
rules.body: Fraunces appears only at Title size and above; it never sets body copy, labels, or button text.

rules.name: The Flat Ledger Rule
rules.body: No box-shadow appears anywhere, in any state. Separation is a border or background change only.

dos: Do keep orange to one mark per view: one button, one status dot, or one highlighted headline word.
Do alternate Passport Paper and Manila Folder Sand section backgrounds for rhythm.
Do use a 1px Ledger Line border as the only separation mechanic — never a shadow.
Do keep real numbers (THB amounts, week counts, visa codes) in the mono label voice.
Do firm a card's border from Ledger Line to Warm Document Ink on hover as the primary interactive affordance.
donts: Don't build a cold blue corporate-agency template.
Don't build a delicate boutique law-firm look.
Don't use an icon-grid services section with generic line icons.
Don't add any box-shadow anywhere, in any state.
Don't let orange spread into a background wash or cover more than ~10% of a view.
Don't set body copy, labels, or button text in Fraunces.
Don't use full-bleed generic stock photography.
